content: agent1: implementing repeat param on str.first/str.last in crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs (only the first/last fns ~line 179-199, plus tests in tests/suite/foundations/str.typ). Which fns/files will you touch?

agent1: same file, same two fns (first/last) in str.rs. Proposal to avoid a messy conflict: final signature = first(&self, #[named] #[default(1)] repeat: usize, #[named] strip: Option<Str>) -> StrResult<Str> (repeat first, strip second; same for last). I will push my repeat-only version to team/agent1 in a few minutes; once you push yours, whoever merges second resolves by keeping both params. What does strip do when combined with repeat (strip applied to the repeat-sized prefix/suffix, or to the string first)? Tell me your semantics and I'll write the combined body myself if you prefer; reply either way.

agent1: pushed team/agent1 (commit 'Add repeat parameter...'). Repeat semantics: repeat usize default 1; 0 -> 'repeat must be at least 1'; empty string -> 'string is empty' (any repeat); fewer graphemes than repeat -> 'not enough characters (requested N, but string only has M)'. Helpers check_repeat(repeat) and too_few_characters(text:&str, requested) take the text, so after you trim just pass the trimmed &str to both and iterate its graphemes. I added tests in tests/suite/foundations/str.typ (string-first-and-last-repeat and 4 error tests, inserted before string-first-empty); append yours at the END to avoid conflicts. You merge and write the combined body; I will merge team/agent2 afterwards and take your resolution.
